{{Quote|Those are Salissian mercenaries. I had heard that Dooku had some working for him here.''"<br />"''Yep. Some are mechanics, some run the harvesters&mdash;not many battle droids are programmed to pick the local produce, which is why, ultimately, we are all here on this fetid dungheap of a world. A few are special troop, recon, like that, who can go places and do things droids don't do too well&mdash;climb trees, covert, those kinds of things. Sometimes only a humanoid will do. And Salissians will do just about any-thing as long as there's a few credits at the other end of it.|[[Barriss Offee/Legends|Barriss Offee]] and Den Dhur|<ref name="Battle Surgeons" />}}
The '''Salissians''' were [[Human/Legends|Humans]] from the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories']] [[Salissia system/Legends|Salissia system]]. During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], many Salissians worked for the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] as [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenaries]], either serving in combat or in other supporting roles such as [[Technician/Legends|mechanics]]. A group of elite Salissian combat [[Troop/Legends|troops]] fought at the [[Battle of Drongar]] in [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]]. Many were [[Death/Legends|killed]] by [[Phow Ji]], a combat instructor for the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. His attack was captured by a [[Cam droid/Legends|cam droid]], and although Ji died in the skirmish, his actions were later immortalized by the Republic, both in documentary form and with a statue on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. Other Salissians served the future [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]] leader, [[Prince/Legends|Prince]] [[Xizor/Legends|Xizor]].

==Biology and appearance==
The Salissians were base-line [[Human/Legends|Humans]]<ref name="Battle Surgeons" /> from the [[Salissia system/Legends|Salissia system]].<ref name="TEAOC" /><ref name="Planetnamia" />

==Society and culture==
{{Quote|Ugly bunch of folks, just as soon shoot you as look at you. Probably rather shoot than look at you.|Den Dhur|<ref name="Battle Surgeons" />}}
Salissian [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenaries]] had a reputation for violence. They were thought to be willing to do any task, provided there was adequate remuneration.<ref name="Battle Surgeons" />

==History==
{{Quote|They were mercenaries, pretty much the scum of the galaxy, on a battlefield, and it was three against one.|Den Dhur describes the fight between Phow Ji and the Salissians|<ref name="Battle Surgeons" />}}
The Salissians<ref name="Battle Surgeons" /> were from the Salissia [[Star system/Legends|star system]],<ref name="TEAOC" /><ref name="Planetnamia" /> located in the eastern expanse of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]], near the [[Overic Griplink/Legends|Overic Griplink]].<ref name="TEAOC" /> During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], Salissian mercenaries worked for [[Count/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]] and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] on the planet [[Drongar/Legends|Drongar]]. The world was home to the [[Bota/Legends|bota]] [[Plant/Legends|plant]], valued by both the Confederacy and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], and as a consequence, the planet was [[Battle of Drongar|heavily contested]] in [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]]. The Salissians on Drongar worked in a variety of roles, including as [[Technician/Legends|mechanics]], [[Pilot/Legends|drivers]], and [[Soldier/Legends|soldiers]].<ref name="Battle Surgeons" />

Three members of the Salissian [[Special forces/Legends|special forces]] were looting the wreckage of a skirmish between Confederacy [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droids]] and Republic [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] when they encountered the [[Bunduki/Legends|Bunduki]] [[Phow Ji]]. Ji was a deadly melee fighter&mdash;having been a former [[Teräs Käsi/Legends|Teräs Käsi]] champion&mdash;and was working as a combat instructor for the Republic forces on Drongar. He engaged the Salissians, [[Death/Legends|killing]] all three in blindingly quick strikes, and taking a trophy from their bodies. The attack was captured by a [[Cam droid/Legends|cam droid]] that was eventually retrieved by the [[Sullustan/Legends|Sullustan]] [[Journalist/Legends|journalist]] [[Den Dhur]].<ref name="Battle Surgeons" /> Later, an elite Salissian combat team undergoing training on Drongar<ref name="Jedi Healer">''[[MedStar II: Jedi Healer]]''</ref> encountered Ji in a clearing on the planet's surface. Initially, three soldiers were felled by pinpoint [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] shots by Ji. Two more mercenaries, accompanied by a [[B2-series super battle droid/Legends|B2 super battle droid]], emerged from the forest, and were also killed by Ji; one's neck was snapped by the Bunduki. When two more mercenaries approached, Ji shot their blasters out of their hands before engaging them in hand-to-hand combat. He killed these and two others, before slowly being overwhelmed by the Confederate forces. Ji struck the last blow, detonating a [[thermal grenade]] to take his own life and those of the mercenaries surrounding him. This second fight was also captured by cam [[Droid/Legends|droid]], this time prearranged by Ji. The footage was sent to Dhur,<ref name="Battle Surgeons" /> who wrote a scathing article on Ji, whom he believed to be a psychopath. However, Dhur's editors rewrote the story, painting Ji's massacre of the Salissians as heroic.<ref name="CN">''[[Coruscant Nights I: Jedi Twilight]]''</ref> The Salissians' defeat at the hands of Ji was later made into a [[HoloNet News/Legends|HoloNet News]] documentary, calling Ji the "The Martyr of Drongar,"<ref name="Jedi Healer" /> and [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] dedicated a statue to Ji at [[Monument Plaza/Legends|Monument Plaza]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].<ref name="CN" />

In [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]], a number of Salissians worked for the [[Falleen/Legends|Falleen]] [[Prince/Legends|Prince]] [[Xizor/Legends|Xizor]], a contender for leader of the [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]] criminal organization. They were hired to eliminate some of the [[Feral droid]]s that were rampant in the [[Factory District]] of Coruscant.<ref name="CN" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Salissians were created by [[Michael Reaves]] and [[Steve Perry]] for their novel ''[[MedStar I: Battle Surgeons]]'', published by [[Del Rey]] in [[2004]].
